use_when: 相机
拍照
录像
预览
闪光灯
焦距

在自定义相机模块中配置相机会话和拍照/录像输出，开启 HDR Vivid 高动态范围拍摄并控制预览、曝光与对焦 / Configure a camera session and photo/video outputs in a custom camera module to enable HDR Vivid high-dynamic-range capture with preview, exposure, and focus control
如何使用CameraPicker直接拉起系统相机拍照和录像
如何实现相机预览、拍照和录像的基础功能（ArkTS/C/C++）
如何控制相机的闪光灯、曝光、对焦和白平衡
如何实现HDR Vivid高动态范围拍照和录像
如何实现多摄像头同时开启（多摄同开）
如何实现动态照片（Motion Photo）拍摄
如何实现分段式拍照和分段式拍照实践
如何在Worker线程中使用相机
如何适配折叠屏设备的摄像头变更
如何实现安全相机模式开发
当你需要开发一个完整的相机应用或应用内的相机模块，需要精确控制相机硬件进行预览、拍照和录像时，可以使用Camera Kit提供的设备管理、会话管理和输出管理接口，支持ArkTS和C/C++两种开发语言
当你仅需要简单拍照或录像而不需要自定义相机界面时，可以直接使用CameraPicker拉起系统相机完成拍摄
当需要高级特性如HDR Vivid、动态照片、安全相机、多摄同开、折叠屏适配时，可以使用Camera Kit提供的相应高级接口
集成拍照页面并把照片保存到相册 / Integrate a capture screen and save photos to the gallery

在自定义相机页面通过Camera Kit管理相机设备输入、CaptureSession、预览流和VideoOutput，实现带对焦/曝光控制的摄像头录像 / Build a custom camera screen that uses Camera Kit to manage camera device input, CaptureSession, preview stream, and VideoOutput for camera hardware video capture with focus/exposure control
接入系统相机选择器快速完成拍照或录像 / Integrate the system camera picker for quick photo or video capture
显示相机取景画面并切换前后摄像头 / Show the camera preview and switch between front and rear cameras
获取相机帧数据做实时图像处理 / Get camera frame data for real-time image processing
实现点击屏幕对焦并联动曝光测光 / Implement tap-to-focus with exposure metering
管理相机缩放倍数并支持捏合变焦 / Manage camera zoom and support pinch-to-zoom
设置照片分辨率和视频录制清晰度 / Set photo resolution and video recording quality
在拍摄时控制闪光灯和手电筒模式 / Control flash and torch modes during capture
实现连拍或定时拍照功能 / Implement burst capture or timed photo shooting
接入多路摄像头同步采集画面 / Integrate synchronized capture from multiple cameras
用 CameraOutput 拍照录像并管理输出流 / Use CameraOutput to capture photos and videos and manage output streams
do_not_use_when: 需求是6DoF运动跟踪、平面检测、语义理解、深度估计、网格扫描或人脸/人体跟踪等增强现实能力，应改用 ar-engine / The task is augmented reality with 6DoF motion tracking, plane detection, semantic understanding, depth estimation, mesh scanning, or face/body tracking; use ar-engine instead
preconditions: 应用已在 module.json5 中声明相机权限；如涉及录像收音，还需声明麦克风权限 / The app has declared camera permission in module.json5; if recording with audio, microphone permission is also declared
用户已授予相机运行时权限；如录像含音频，麦克风权限也已授予 / The user has granted runtime camera permission; if recording with audio, microphone permission is also granted
目标设备存在可用摄像头并支持所请求的能力（如闪光灯、HDR、多摄同开） / The target device has an available camera and supports the requested capabilities such as flash, HDR, or multi-camera
应用具备可用于预览或输出的界面/Surface/流接收端配置 / The app has UI, Surface, or stream receiver configuration available for preview or output
inputs: 相机设备或镜头标识 / camera device or lens identifier
预览输出目标（如 Surface、XComponent 或预览控件） / preview output target such as a Surface, XComponent, or preview view
拍照或录像参数配置 / photo or video parameter configuration
相机会话控制参数（如对焦、曝光、变焦、闪光灯） / camera session control parameters such as focus, exposure, zoom, and flash
outputs: 相机管理器 CameraManager / CameraManager object
可用相机设备列表 CameraDevice[] / list of available CameraDevice objects
相机输出能力 CameraOutputCapability / CameraOutputCapability describing supported preview, photo, video and metadata profiles
相机输入流 CameraInput / CameraInput stream bound to a selected camera device
拍摄会话 CaptureSession、PhotoSession、VideoSession 等 / CaptureSession, PhotoSession, VideoSession and related session objects
预览输出流 PreviewOutput / PreviewOutput stream for preview frames
预览画面 Surface 帧数据 / preview frame data delivered to a Surface
拍照输出流 PhotoOutput / PhotoOutput stream for still capture
拍照结果 Photo 或 image.Image 图像数据 / captured Photo or image.Image data
JPEG/HEIF/YUV 等格式的照片文件或图像缓存 / photo files or image buffers such as JPEG, HEIF or YUV
录像输出流 VideoOutput / VideoOutput stream for video recording
录制生成的视频文件或写入的文件描述符内容 / recorded video file or media data written to a file descriptor
元数据输出流 MetadataOutput / MetadataOutput stream
人脸、焦点、曝光等相机元数据 MetadataObject[] / camera metadata objects such as face, focus and exposure metadata
HDR Vivid 照片或视频结果 / HDR Vivid photo or video output
动态照片 Motion Photo 媒体结果 / Motion Photo media output
分段式拍照生成的分段图像结果 / staged-capture image results
多摄同开产生的多路预览或拍摄输出流 / multiple concurrent preview or capture output streams from multi-camera mode
CameraPicker 返回的拍照或录像结果 URI / photo or video result URI returned by CameraPicker

postconditions.statement: 代码中已创建并配置相机输入、会话以及至少一种输出流（预览、拍照或录像） / The code creates and configures camera input, a session, and at least one output stream (preview, photo, or video)
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code to initialize a camera device/input, create or configure a camera session, and attach at least one preview/photo/video output?

postconditions.statement: 代码包含相机权限申请或权限校验逻辑；如涉及录像收音，也处理了麦克风权限 / The code includes camera permission request or permission-check logic; if recording with audio, it also handles microphone permission
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there explicit camera permission handling, and if audio recording is involved, microphone permission handling as well?

postconditions.statement: 相机能力相关参数仅在代码中按需配置，例如对焦、曝光、闪光灯、HDR或变焦 / Camera capability-related parameters are configured in code only as needed, such as focus, exposure, flash, HDR, or zoom
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits show camera-specific controls or session parameters being configured to match the requested feature, instead of unrelated media or image-only APIs?
